properties.headline: Heat Advisory issued October 7 at 6:58AM PDT until October 8 at 10:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures up to 98.

* WHERE...The East Bay and San Francisco Bay Shoreline, North Bay
Interior Mountains and Valleys, The Santa Clara Valley and Eastern
Hills, The Santa Cruz Mountains, Interior Monterey County and the
Santa Lucia Range, Most of San Benito County and the Cholame Hills
in Southeast Monterey County, and Southern Salinas Valley/Arroyo
Seco and Lake San Antonio.

* WHEN...Until 10 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...This level of heat affects anyone without effective
cooling and/or adequate hydration. Impacts likely in some health
systems, heat-sensitive industries and infrastructure.
properties.instruction:
Hydration is a critical piece to surviving the heat. Drink water, and
if possible, take water to those who are vulnerable.

Take extra precautions when outside. Wear lightweight and loose
fitting clothing. Try to limit strenuous activities to the early
morning or evening. Take action when you experience symptoms of heat
exhaustion and/or heat stroke.

properties.areaDesc: Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued October 7 at 10:45AM EDT until October 7 at 11:45AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
SMWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm...

* Until 1145 AM EDT.

* At 1044 AM EDT, a shower capable of producing waterspouts was
located near Klondike Beach, or near Playalinda Beach. The shower
was nearly stationary.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can create locally hazardous seas. Make sure
all on board are wearing life jackets. Expect wind gusts
in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher waves, lightning
and heavy downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing
life jackets. Return to safe harbor if possible.

* Locations impacted include...
Klondike Beach, Playalinda Beach, Haulover Canal, and Merritt
Island Wildlife Refuge.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally hazardous
seas. Seek safe harbor immediately.

properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 7 at 7:36AM PDT until October 9 at 11:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Minor to locally moderate coastal flooding with elevated
surf and dangerous rip currents expected.

* WHERE...Catalina and Santa Barbara Islands, Ventura County
Beaches, Malibu Coast and Los Angeles County Beaches.

* WHEN...Until 11 PM PDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Moderate flooding of sea water is likely over some
vulnerable low-lying coastal areas, especially around the time
of high tide, including over beach parking lots, bike paths,
and harbor walkways. Moderate beach erosion is likely.
Isolated damage is unlikely but possible in most vulnerable
areas. There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can
wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Areas of most concern regarding coastal
flooding impacts are the beaches from Malibu to Ventura
especially on Thursday and Friday. These products will likely
need to be extended into the weekend.
properties.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. Do
NOT drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth.

Remain out of the water due to hazardous swimming conditions, or
stay near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly
in such conditions, stay off the rocks.
